description: Defines classes and data structures for managing audio client descriptors within Android's audio policy framework, including ClientDescriptor, TrackClientDescriptor, RecordClientDescriptor, and related collection and handler classes.

classes.name: ClientDescriptor
classes.description: Base class representing an audio client with properties like port ID, UID, session ID, attributes, config, preferred device, and activity status.

classes.name: TrackClientDescriptor
classes.description: Derived class representing a track client with additional properties such as stream type, strategy, volume source, flags, secondary outputs, and primary mix.

classes.name: RecordClientDescriptor
classes.description: Derived class representing a recording client with properties like unique ID, source, flags, and effect management.

classes.name: SourceClientDescriptor
classes.description: Derived class representing a source client with connection management to devices and output descriptors.

classes.name: InternalSourceClientDescriptor
classes.description: Specialized client descriptor for internal audio patches, marked as internal.

classes.name: SourceClientCollection
classes.description: Collection class for managing multiple source client descriptors.

classes.name: ClientMapHandler
classes.description: Template class managing a map of client descriptors keyed by port ID, with iteration and management functions.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a textual representation of the object for debugging.

methods.name: toShortString
methods.description: Returns a brief string summary of the object.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active state of the client.

methods.name: changeActivityCount
methods.description: Adjusts the activity count for the client, affecting its active status.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a source client to a device via a patch handle.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a source client from its current device.

methods.name: setSwOutput
methods.description: Associates a software output descriptor with the source client.

methods.name: setHwOutput
methods.description: Associates a hardware output descriptor with the source client.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a textual representation of the collection of source clients.
